chunks: “Sitting after the dawn prayer in ta'qib and supplication until the sun rises is more effective in seeking sustenance than traveling through the earth.”

key_terms.التَّعْقِيبِ: post-prayer devotional remembrance and acts following salat
key_terms.الضَّرْبِ فِي الْأَرْضِ: traveling or striving through the land for livelihood

ai.seo_question: How does sitting in ta'qib and du'a after Fajr affect one's sustenance?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches the spiritual value of remaining after salat al-ghadah in ta'qib and du'a until sunrise. The hadith emphasizes that seeking rizq is not only through physical labor, but also through devotion, remembrance, and supplication to Allah.
